title: Excel
description: Exposes Microsoft Excel operations as agent tools.

List worksheets and tables; read, write, and clear ranges; add worksheets, tables, table rows, and charts; recalculate; create workbooks. Operates on xlsx files in the acting user's OneDrive via the Microsoft Graph workbook API.
Authenticates via an Entra app (client credentials) or user OAuth.

excel.access.title: Access level
excel.access.description: Graph scopes to request. readonly: read worksheets, ranges, and tables only. write: full read/write (update ranges, add worksheets/tables/charts, create workbooks).
